subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The Future of Roasting Technology
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Roasting Technology.

hook.text: AI-assisted roasting machines can now analyze bean color in real-time and adjust heat automatically for optimal results.

buildup.text: Near-infrared sensors, machine learning, and computer vision are entering commercial roasters for precision control.

discovery.text: These systems reduce human error and make high-quality roasting accessible even without years of training.

twist.text: Purists argue that AI removes the craft element. They compare it to autopilot in aviation—effective but soulless.

climax.text: The most likely future combines both: AI handles precision while humans make the creative decisions about profile design.

punchline.text: AI for consistency, humans for creativity. Roasting's future is a partnership.

quiz.question: How is AI being used in modern coffee roasting?
options: It analyzes bean color in real-time and adjusts heat for precision
It selects which beans to buy
